sources.title: CENDI Indexing Workshop, NASA Conference Publication 10160
sources.sections_read: Overview and Evaluation/Criteria for Evaluating Inter-Indexer Consistency, printed pp. 78–88 (PDF pp. 90–99), especially the coefficient definitions on printed p. 88
sources.confirmed: The later workshop material defines pair consistency using term agreements divided by unique assigned terms and group consistency as a mean of pair coefficients. It cites Rodgers (1961) and Hooper (1965) as antecedents. This is a later application, not a reproduced Hooper report.
sources.limits: Does not establish what Hooper's original report said or resolve the report-number discrepancy. Term-set overlap is not the same denominator as agreement on one role label per sampled unit.
